Why desperate pleading never gets you heard.

Kevin Trudeau says the more you babble, beg and plead, the less God listens. You end up on the wrong frequency, and he says the other side simply can't hear you.

His example is the "please, please, I'll do anything" kind of prayer. He says that is how not to pray.

How would you ask differently if you were not desperate?
